tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient observations establish a sharp regime change, but its behavior on fresh inputs remains unresolved. Two stationary candidate mechanisms have been refuted, so a reliable quantitative law cannot be confirmed from the available evidence.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Two fitted branch models failed fresh confirmation, including one with essentially zero training error; the available observations do not identify a reliable branch.
Both available informative probe batches have already been acquired; the nuisance auxiliary probe is irrelevant.
